name: Parents With Addictions
overview: Scripture reveals that those struggling with addiction are enslaved to sin, as Jesus declares that committing sin makes one a servant to it. However, true freedom comes only through the Son, who liberates believers from this bondage. Christians are called to resist temptation by watching and praying, acknowledging the weakness of the flesh, and to clothe themselves with Christ rather than yielding to fleshly desires. Standing firm in the liberty Christ provides prevents believers from becoming entangled again in the chains of sin.
